description: Change #1: Canonical root .env loaded cwd-independently. Fix server/src/config.ts so the root .env is loaded based on the module's own location (not process.cwd()), so it works both under `npm run dev:server` (cwd=server/) and when run from repo root, and does NOT require a server/.env. This is the foundation feature; verify the existing baseline is green first.
steps: Run `npm test` from repo root to confirm the 133/133 baseline is green before making changes.

In server/src/config.ts, replace the bare `import "dotenv/config"` with an explicit dotenv load that resolves the repo-root .env from the module location. Use `import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url"`, `import path from "node:path"`, `import dotenv from "dotenv"`. Compute the source file dir via `path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` (this is server/src at runtime, or server/dist for compiled), then resolve upward to the repo root. The repo root is two levels up from server/src (server/src -> server -> repo root) and also two levels up from server/dist. Call `dotenv.config({ path: <resolvedRootEnvPath> })`.
Preserve standard dotenv precedence: real process.env vars already set must NOT be overridden by the .env file (default dotenv behavior; do not pass override:true).

Do NOT change DATABASE_PATH resolution semantics: DATABASE_PATH default stays 'data/app.db' and is still resolved relative to cwd as it is today. Only change WHERE the .env file is read from, not how DATABASE_PATH is interpreted. This keeps seed (cwd=server/, writes server/data/app.db) and e2e tests (in-memory) working unchanged.
Keep all existing config values, defaults, loadConfig()/getConfig() signatures and behavior identical. Never print or log the API key.
Verify seed still works: `npm run seed` must print 7 OK lines and 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations).' and write to server/data/app.db as before.

Add a focused test server/test/config.test.ts that proves cwd-independent root .env loading: e.g. spawn a tiny node process (or use execSync) with cwd set to server/ and to repo root, importing/using loadConfig, and assert config resolves the same way and that a value only present in the root .env is picked up. Alternatively, test that the resolved dotenv path points at the repo-root .env computed from module location. Do NOT hit the network. Keep it deterministic and fast.
acceptance_criteria: server/src/config.ts loads the repo-root .env via a path derived from import.meta.url (module location), not from process.cwd().
Backend reads OPENROUTER_* and other root .env vars when started via `npm run dev:server` (cwd=server/) without any server/.env file existing.
`npm run seed` still prints 7 OK lines and 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations).'
Existing 133 tests still pass; a new config test proves cwd-independent root .env loading.
Real environment variables still take precedence over the .env file (no override:true).
verification: Run `npm test` from repo root and confirm all tests (existing + new config test) pass.
Run `npm run seed` and confirm 7 OK lines + 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations).'
Run `npm run build` and confirm zero errors.
findings:
Baseline confirmed 133/133 green before changes. Replaced the bare `import "dotenv/config"` in server/src/config.ts with an explicit, cwd-independent load: computed moduleDir via path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) then repoRootEnvPath = path.resolve(moduleDir, '..', '..', '.env') and called dotenv.config({ path: repoRootEnvPath }). Two levels up works for BOTH server/src/config.ts (register-hook runtime) and server/dist/config.js (compiled); verified the compiled dist still contains import.meta.url. No override:true, so real process.env still wins (standard precedence preserved). DATABASE_PATH semantics untouched (still 'data/app.db' relative to cwd); seed writes server/data/app.db as before. loadConfig()/getConfig() signatures and defaults unchanged. Added server/test/config.test.ts (4 tests) proving cwd-independence: (1) root .env exists and server/.env does not; (2) loadConfig yields identical config from cwd=server/ and cwd=repo-root (spawned via the TS register hook, matching dev/seed); (3) root-.env non-secret values (PORT, DATABASE_PATH, OPENROUTER_MODEL, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL) load with cwd=server/; (4) an isolated sandbox copied inside the repo (so node_modules/dotenv still resolves upward) with a unique sentinel OPENROUTER_MODEL in its own root .env proves the value only-in-root-.env is read anchored to module location even with cwd=<sandbox>/server. Never printed/logged/committed the API key. Verification: npm test 137/137 pass; npm run build zero errors (server tsc + web tsc/vite); npm run seed prints 7 OK lines + 'Seeded 7 scenarios (7 matched expectations).'; npm run dev:server boots with cwd=server/ (no server/.env) and /api/health returns {status:ok,paymentMode:simulation,llm:openrouter}. Did NOT commit or push per instructions (a later step commits on main). Changed files: server/src/config.ts (modified), server/test/config.test.ts (new).

FOLLOW-UP (review 2026-09-05-000600 Finding 1): after the cwd-independent .env fix, the shipped root .env/.env.example placeholder OPENROUTER_API_KEY=PASTE_YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_HERE was being read as a real key, flipping the zero-config demo to the OpenRouter adapter (401 on every /explain), contradicting the README promise of a deterministic default. FIX in loadConfig() (server/src/config.ts): after readString("OPENROUTER_API_KEY"), treat the value as undefined when it is an obvious placeholder via isPlaceholderOpenRouterKey() — exact case-insensitive match of the sentinel PASTE_YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_HERE OR any value still containing the substring "paste_your". A genuine key is honored unchanged, so OpenRouter still enables with a real key and honest source/model reporting is unweakened. Added 3 focused tests to server/test/config.test.ts using loadConfig(envOverride) with an explicit env object (no real .env, no network): (a) placeholder -> openRouter.enabled===false and apiKey undefined; (b) case-varied placeholder -> disabled; (c) genuine non-placeholder key -> enabled===true with apiKey set. Also added a clarifying NON-SECRET comment to .env.example (placeholder VALUE unchanged; no real key added). Verified via loadConfig() with the shipped placeholder: {enabled:false, hasKey:false, model:'openai/gpt-4o-mini'} — deterministic default restored, model still honestly reported. npm test now 150 passing; npm run build zero errors; npm run seed still 7 OK + '7 matched expectations'. Changed files this follow-up: server/src/config.ts, server/test/config.test.ts, .env.example (comment only).
